method: Strong routes found by a bounded ordinary-input search, not proof of absolute maximum damage. The defender guards after the first hit. All contacts must remain in one combo. No mid-combo position, health, hitstun, wall damage or tuning edits. Tapper stance is earned through an input prelude; its setup damage is excluded. Anvil’s super example starts with 50% Momentum. Native recording verifies every simulation checksum.
